First, 09-13-1753 is September 13, 1753.  
Subtract 67 days:  
From September 13, go back 13 days to September 0 → August 31.  
Remaining days: 67 - 13 = 54 days to subtract from August 31.  
August has 31 days, so back 31 days to July 31. Remaining: 54 - 31 = 23 days.  
July 31 minus 23 days = July 8, 1753.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1753-07-08
